case.t0_rule: WHO declaration of a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (docs/DAC_PPE_CODING.md §2)
case.response_scale: French State (ministry of health, DGS, Santé publique France); regional, departmental and local acts are context
case.start_rule: First purchase order or contract for PPE for general supply; inquiries, options, tenders and single-mission purchases excluded (the 30 January order, used mainly for the Wuhan teams, is excluded)

inclusion_rules.firm_order: First national purchase order or contract for PPE for general supply
inclusion_rules.binding_act: First legally binding national act concerning the PPE response
inclusion_rules.dedicated_funding: First funding legally earmarked for the PPE response
inclusion_rules.delivery: First physical delivery of masks to pharmacies (officines) supplying health professionals
inclusion_rules.institutionalisation: First permanent body created for the hazard

observation_window.reason: First wave; opens 1 Jan so that pre-t0 events can be context (docs/DAC_PPE_CODING.md §5)

searched: Sénat, rapport no. 199 (2020-2021), tome I, full text (fetched by scripts/fetch_dac_ppe_sources.py, sha256 27bfb9b1..., identical to Adrian's copy); searched pp. 28-153, 180-213, 323-400
not_accessed: Légifrance texts of the decrees and arrêtés cited
Santé publique France order data cited by the report

case.identification: Not testable: the source dates no verified delivery of any national order, so no order is paired with its own delivery (rule §5, France c). The interval from first order to first pharmacy delivery is unpaired.

events.description: WHO declares a Public Health Emergency of International Concern ('30/01 L'OMS déclare l'USSPI')
events.source: Sénat, rapport no. 199 (2020-2021), commission d'enquête COVID-19, tome I, PDF p. 30 (timeline) and p. 37

events.description: WHO declares a pandemic (alternative t0); not in the Sénat report, cited from the Belgian chronology (rule §5, France b)
events.source: Chambre, Commission spéciale COVID-19, DOC 55 1394/002 (2021), Annexe 5, PDF p. 363, row 51 (CRIV K001, De Raedt)

events.description: Santé publique France to the minister: strategic stock of 33 million paediatric and 66 million adult (surgical) masks; no FFP2; a further order of 10.6 + 54.6 million expected
events.source: Sénat, rapport no. 199 (2020-2021), commission d'enquête COVID-19, tome I, PDF p. 105

events.description: Santé publique France order of 1.1 million FFP2 and 322,000 gowns; main recipients the medical teams sent to Wuhan and the Carry-le-Rouet quarantine centre (single mission, excluded by the start rule)
events.source: Sénat, rapport no. 199 (2020-2021), commission d'enquête COVID-19, tome I, PDF pp. 114-115

events.description: First firm order for general supply: 28.4 million FFP2 (plus gloves, caps, goggles, overshoes, gel) for hospitals, care homes and community practice, reading A: date of the DGS request ('le lendemain' of the 6 Feb note; 'commande du 7 février … adressée aux quatre fabricants historiques')
events.source: Sénat, rapport no. 199 (2020-2021), commission d'enquête COVID-19, tome I, PDF p. 115 and p. 146

events.description: First firm order, reading B: 'l'une des deux premières commandes d'ampleur, validée le 19 février pour un volume de 8 millions de masques FFP2, ne prévoit aucune livraison avant le 29 mai' (rule §5, France a)
events.source: Sénat, rapport no. 199 (2020-2021), commission d'enquête COVID-19, tome I, PDF p. 123

events.description: Order of 170.5 million FFP2 ('La première commande massive de masques FFP2 aura lieu le 25 février')
events.source: Sénat, rapport no. 199 (2020-2021), commission d'enquête COVID-19, tome I, PDF p. 116 and p. 146

events.description: Pharmacies volunteer as the distribution point of masks for community health professionals
events.source: Sénat, rapport no. 199 (2020-2021), commission d'enquête COVID-19, tome I, PDF pp. 141-142

events.description: Community health professionals informed of the surgical-mask distribution channel via pharmacies (announcement, not a delivery)
events.source: Sénat, rapport no. 199 (2020-2021), commission d'enquête COVID-19, tome I, PDF p. 49

events.description: Décret n° 2020-190 du 3 mars 2020: requisition of stocks of protective masks (FFP2 and surgical)
events.source: Sénat, rapport no. 199 (2020-2021), commission d'enquête COVID-19, tome I, PDF p. 131 (footnote 1)

events.description: Décret n° 2020-247 du 13 mars 2020: requisition extended to masks produced in France 13 March - 31 May
events.source: Sénat, rapport no. 199 (2020-2021), commission d'enquête COVID-19, tome I, PDF p. 131

events.description: Arrêté du 11 mars 2020: exceptional allocation of EUR 260 million to Santé publique France 'au titre de la prévention épidémique et de la constitution de stocks stratégiques' (raised to 860 million on 20 March, 4 billion on 30 March)
events.source: Sénat, rapport no. 199 (2020-2021), commission d'enquête COVID-19, tome I, PDF p. 352

events.description: First delivery of state-stock masks to pharmacies (officines) for community health professionals. Window: the week before the week of 17 March (wholesalers 'sollicités … pour une première livraison de masques aux officines') to the end of the week of 17 March (Geodis delivery to pharmacies)
events.source: Sénat, rapport no. 199 (2020-2021), commission d'enquête COVID-19, tome I, PDF p. 142 and p. 141
events.source_wording: 'les grossistes-répartiteurs avaient déjà été sollicités, la semaine précédente, pour une première livraison de masques aux officines' (p. 142); 'renoncer à leurs services pendant la semaine du 17 mars et de confier l'une des livraisons à l'entreprise Geodis' (p. 141)

events.description: Prefect of Haut-Rhin requisitions a masks order placed by the Grand Est ARS and local authorities at Bâle-Mulhouse airport (State against local procurement; not in the national profile)
events.source: Sénat, rapport no. 199 (2020-2021), commission d'enquête COVID-19, tome I, PDF pp. 134-135

events.description: No permanent body for the hazard created within the window found (the CCIL-MS is a crisis cell)
events.source: Sénat, rapport no. 199 (2020-2021), commission d'enquête COVID-19, tome I, searched PDF pp. 95-153 and 323-352
